title: ConsentGranted payload
description: A party agreed to a defined set of uses of their data and participation (CONSENT-002). Carried inside the canonical envelope.

languageTag.description: Consent obtained in a language the party does not read is not consent, so downstream consumers can check this rather than assume it.

_note: Carries no evidence asset reference and no witness identity. The grant record holds those; an event stream is retained and forwarded widely, and a consent form is a document about a person.
